note: Montgomery County KS has adopted zoning regulations (11 districts) whose official district maps are referenced only as PDFs; the county GIS page and parcel search expose no zoning district service. Coffeyville publishes its zoning map only as a PDF (DocumentCenter/View/3259). Independence city zoning found on ArcGIS Online is the Missouri city's (independence.maps.arcgis.com), not Kansas. The only commercial source with zoning fields (Dynamo Spatial parcel shapefile) is paywalled via inquiry form. No queryable public zoning polygon layer found for Montgomery County, KS.
